steps: Write the angular displacement for the first wheel: θ₁ = (1/2)α₁t² = (π/4)t².
Write the angular displacement for the second wheel: θ₂ = (1/2)α₂t² = (π/8)t².
For the dots to align again for the first time, the difference in their angular displacements must be exactly 2π.
Set up the equation: θ₁ - θ₂ = 2π.
Substitute the expressions: (π/4)t² - (π/8)t² = 2π, which simplifies to (π/8)t² = 2π.
Solve for t: t² = 16, so t = 4 seconds.
